old: Third-party personal AI assistants can no longer book United Airlines flights, manage reservations or enter MileagePlus accounts under digital policy changes the carrier announced on November 11, 2026.[^1]
new: United Airlines announced on November 11, 2026, that it is restricting unauthorized third-party personal AI agents from accessing its systems to book flights or manage reservations.[^1]
why: The United release opened for this revision does not support the previous wording; the correction follows its actual text.

support.quote: As a result, United is taking steps to restrict access - directly within our digital platforms and indirectly via travel agencies and aggregators - to prohibit use by unauthorized, third-party personal AI agents or assistants.

old: United said personal AI agents are "currently unregulated and operate without uniform standards for consumer protection, privacy, and data security".[^1]
new: United said it is restricting unauthorized personal AI agents to protect customer data and accounts.[^1]
